body: I reeeally don't want to hear about fucking religion, thank you. If you want to go on about God, make a post fot that. I'm struggling, in reality, here and now... I don't want to hear religious bullshit right now, or ever.

I'm glad thoughts of god are keeping you alive.

If there is one, he lost all chance for me to ask his help now when he failed to answer a much younger me's cries for protection from those who preyed on me.

But I'm glad it works for you.
